basis_kinds.named_in_test: the requirement identifier appears in the test file source
basis_kinds.remediation_record: requirement_id of a requirement_results case of the remediation record of the REM the test belongs to
basis_kinds.subject_task: requirement_ids of the backlog task whose deliverable the test exercises, with the recorded rationale; used only when no other basis exists
basis_kinds.task_binding: requirement_ids of the backlog task that owns the test file (expected_file_areas or test_ocor_dev_NNNN name)

nature: NON-NORMATIVE index of the reverse traceability of tests (LLD v1.1 §8, docs/OCOR_LLD_v1.1.md:434; NCR-PLAN-006). A binding of kind task_binding, remediation_record or subject_task is a traceability link, not a declaration by the test: only named_in_test is a declaration (scripts/validate_runtime_evidence.py). Not evidence; E1=0, E2=0, Verified=0 unchanged.
